summary: Load cold-conversation syntax grammars on demand while preserving readable code, transcript layout, composer state and keyboard focus; keep plain code available if grammar loading fails.

replay.detail: Client presentation only; no replay changes.

schema.detail: No stored data or schema changes.

rules.detail: No permission or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, wire or data contract changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; failed optional grammar loads retain plain code and can retry on a later render.
